FM08.reasoning: The agent performs a manual min-max scaling of the Cabin_Num feature using the minimum and maximum values from the combined train and test dataset, causing data leakage.

FM04.reasoning: The agent calculates the median age for imputation on the combined train and test dataset prior to splitting, which leaks test set statistics into the training data.

other_failure_modes.name: Feature engineering on combined dataset
other_failure_modes.description: Aggregated feature statistics (like mean, count, or variance of a group) are calculated on the combined train and test dataset before splitting, which leaks test set feature distributions into the training data.

summary: The agent's solution is generally highly sophisticated, demonstrating complex feature engineering, appropriate neural network architecture, and a well-implemented ensemble method. However, by concatenating the train and test sets before performing imputations and feature aggregations, the agent introduces moderate data leakage through cross-dataset statistics.
